en.headline: Discovery Bay Weekend Market continues today at DB Plaza until 6pm
en.dek: Handmade Hong Kong’s two-day gathering of local makers runs from 11am Saturday to 6pm Sunday at Discovery Bay Plaza.
body: The Discovery Bay Weekend Market organised by Handmade Hong Kong continues today at DB Plaza, running until 6pm.

The free outdoor market, which began at 11am on Saturday, features stalls by local independent makers and vendors. Organisers said visitors can browse handmade goods at the plaza on Discovery Bay Road.
The event is open to the public with no admission fee. Similar markets by the same organisers are scheduled later in the month, including a Halloween edition.

zh.headline: 愉景灣週末市集今續辦至下午6時 愉景廣場舉行
zh.dek: 香港手工製作主辦的兩日市集由周六上午11時至周日下午6時於愉景廣場舉行，免費入場。
body: 由香港手工製作主辦的愉景灣週末市集今日繼續於愉景廣場舉行，至下午6時結束。
市集由周六上午11時開始，設本地獨立手作及攤檔。主辦單位表示市民可到愉景灣道愉景廣場免費參觀。
活動免費入場。主辦單位稍後亦會舉辦萬聖節夜市等類似活動。
